Same illustration style in all four cells. Keep prominent composition low central, soft bookshelf background; no specific count of bookmarks. Top right: front view cozy pine woodworking station in library, pale wheat clear large empty floor and wall in the center for game board, low shelves only at edges, no people. Bottom left: a library reading nook with pale floor and furniture only far left and right, broad open center for a cart crossing board, full-width gentle environment, no people or prominent countable props. Bottom right: same girl with parent at home, discussing an empty tray beside a book, warm calm cream and pine composition, no counted props. All crops maintain the same paper material and hue, quiet backgrounds and clean characters.
